title: Speed Demon
tagline: Stage it, launch it, row the gate clean.
description: A top-down drag racer built around manual-shift execution. Work an H-pattern gate as real geometry, read the christmas tree for a holeshot, and hold the needle in the window every shift. Distance Race over four lengths and Time Attack over three clocks, across a 24-model roster and five tracks, with a server-backed garage for paint, finish, tint, tail lights and underglow — plus Speed Demon Radio, your own music folder played through a car-stereo faceplate.
status: Playable — Distance Race + Time Attack, 24-car customizable garage (Online Versus locked)
